text: まずは　１のしまに　いって　あのへんを　さがそうかなー　じゃ　おさき！

structure.jp: まずは　１のしまに　いって
structure.en: first I'll go to One Island

structure.jp: あのへんを　さがそうかなー

structure.en: well, I'm off ahead of you!

patterns.name: 〜ようかな
patterns.explanation: The 'let's do' form of a verb plus かな is thinking aloud about what you might do. さがそうかなー = 'I guess I'll search'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: The て-form joins one action to the next: do this, then that. いって = 'go, and then'.
